earlier_harness_failures: browser-1 and browser-2 seeded incomplete profiles lacking required schema fields; browser logs confirm recovery to an empty profile. Corrected before acceptance.
browser-3 could not find popup menus through Windows scripting; Haiku excludes BMenuWindow there. Corrected the native probe to enumerate Loopers.
browser-4 passed all checks; browser-5 repeats acceptance after the final import-message correction.
limits: Isolated airOS x86_64 candidate, software page rendering; published-package and stock-Haiku runtime acceptance not performed.

Folder references, time ranges, transitions, OR clauses, annotations, modified-time/frecency sorting and other result groupings are not implemented. Unsupported queries are retained with explanations, not replaced with broader results.
Matching uses ASCII case folding and exact tag names; history is limited to retained page records, not individual Firefox visits.
Clear-history probe exercises the confirmed handler, not the confirmation dialog.
Query pages are captured and visually inspected; native popup/editor pixel layouts were not captured.
